newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel eases closure of West Bank and Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel eases closure of West Bank and Gaza.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Saturday it was slightly easing a tightened two-week old closure of the West Bank and Gaza Strip to let residents reach their homes.

An army spokeswoman said Palestinians living in the West Bank but visiting Gaza when the closure was tightened would be allowed to return home, as would residents of Gaza who were in the West Bank at the time.

Israel closed the areas after a Palestinian suicide bomber killed three Israeli women at a Tel Aviv cafe two weeks ago. A less severe closure has been in effect since a wave of Moslem suicide bombings 13 months ago killed scores of people.
In addition to the travel permits to be issued on Sunday, Israel will allow some 100 Palestinians who work in tourism in the West Bank to enter Israel.
She said 22 additional ambulances would be permitted to travel from the West Bank to Israel in emergencies. Now only 14 are allowed.
